subject: About your request at Cascade Hideaway

Hello Ben,

Thank you for choosing Cascade Hideaway. We are sorry: Fri, Dec 4 to Mon, Dec 7 are no longer available, so we could not confirm this request.

We would still love to host you. Please reply to this e-mail with other dates that suit you, or see what is open at https://tinyurl.com/Stay-at-Cascade, and we will gladly check them for you.

Warm regards,
Cascade Hideaway
